recognize_zh: 明顯疊錢狀紅血球背景中，一顆核偏心、染色質塊狀、胞質淡藍的漿細胞，胞質內擠滿許多細長針狀、成束排列的粉紫色結晶桿狀物，外觀像 Auer 小體；漿細胞含結晶狀包涵體，見於漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus and coarse clock-face chromatin
Pale blue cytoplasm packed with numerous thin, needle-like, pink-violet crystalline rods arranged in bundles (Auer rod-like inclusions)
Rods extend beyond the nucleus into most of the cytoplasm
Striking rouleaux formation of red cells in the background, consistent with a paraprotein
Scattered small lymphocytes and a granulocyte in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked rouleaux formation of red cells, with a plasma cell whose eccentric nucleus has coarsely clumped chromatin and whose pale blue cytoplasm contains numerous thin, needle-like, pink-violet crystalline rods arranged in bundles. These Auer rod-like inclusions represent crystallized immunoglobulin (often kappa light chain) and are distinct from true Auer rods, which are MPO-positive fused primary granules of myeloid blasts. Scattered small lymphocytes are also present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline cytoplasmic inclusions; evaluation for light-chain proximal tubulopathy (Fanconi syndrome) or crystal-storing histiocytosis may be warranted.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO-positive, whereas these crystals lie in a mature plasma cell with clock-face chromatin and are MPO-negative.
Crystals accumulate in CD68+ histiocytes with bland oval nuclei rather than in CD138+ plasma cells, although both reflect the same underlying light-chain disorder.
Gaucher cells are large histiocytes with fibrillar 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm and a small nucleus, not discrete needle-shaped rods in a plasma cell.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round globular inclusions rather than elongated needle-like crystals.
